questions.prompt: Quadrilateral PQRS has PQ ∥ SR. It is rotated 90° about a point O. What is true about P′Q′ and S′R′? Explain.
questions.prompt_markup: Quadrilateral PQRS has PQ ∥ SR. It is rotated 90° about a point O. What is true about P′Q′ and S′R′? Explain.
questions.correct_answer: P′Q′ ∥ S′R′. A rotation maps lines to lines and keeps them from meeting if they did not meet before, so parallel lines stay parallel.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent explanation. Essential: the images are parallel because rigid motions take parallel lines to parallel lines.
